full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio portrait shows a woman from the upper back and shoulders upward, turned three-quarters away but looking back into the camera. Her gaze comes from under slightly lowered brows, giving the face a poised, alert intensity. Short dark hair is shaped into glossy waves and sculpted curls, including a prominent curl resting above the forehead and rounded clusters beside the temples. A small bright earring is visible near the ear on the viewer's right. She wears a dark sleeveless garment with a close dark collar or scarf, leaving one pale shoulder and upper arm exposed in the lower foreground. The face, shoulder, and shining ridges of hair emerge from a nearly black studio background. A soft light from the upper left brings out the forehead, eyes, cheekbone, nose, and front shoulder, while the far side of the neck and clothing fall into deeper shadow. Just left of the head, an indistinct pale oval sits out of focus against the darkness; it does not read as a specific object. The lower body is tightly cropped away, and the head occupies much of the upper frame. The face has smooth graduated gray modeling, while the eye lines, lip outline, and individual hair waves stay sharp. The contrast is high but not featureless: small zones of middle gray remain in the curls and skin. The composition uses a backward glance and triangular shoulder line to create motion within a still pose. Its glamour comes from controlled light, close framing, and a direct exchange of gaze rather than a visible scene or prop.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白影棚肖像从上背和肩部往上拍摄一位女子。她的身体大约转开四分之三，却回头直视相机。目光从略低的眉下投来，使脸部显得沉着而敏锐。短深发被整理成发亮的波浪和雕塑般卷曲，包括额前明显的一束弧形卷发和两侧太阳穴旁圆润的发团。观者右侧耳边可见一枚小亮耳饰。她穿深色无袖衣物，颈部围有贴近的深色领饰或围巾，在下方前景露出一侧浅色肩膀与上臂。脸、肩和发浪亮脊从近乎黑色的影棚背景中浮出。左上方的柔光照亮额头、眼、颧骨、鼻和前肩，颈的远侧及衣服则陷入更深阴影。头部左侧有一枚模糊的淡色椭圆，失焦地停在黑暗中，无法认定具体物件。下半身被紧密裁去，头占据上半画面的大部。脸上有平顺渐变灰阶，眼线、唇线和独立的发浪却保持清楚。反差高但并未丧失细节，卷发与皮肤里仍有少量中间灰。构图利用回望与三角形肩线，让静止姿势中有动作感。其魅力来自受控光线、近距裁切与直接目光交流，而不是可见场景或道具。
style_prompt_en: Classic high-contrast monochrome studio glamour photography with close framing and precise directional light. Sculpted highlights trace hair, facial planes, and a shoulder or other smooth form against a nearly black ground. Preserve soft gray transitions across skinlike surfaces while allowing clothing and background shadows to merge. Keep small defining lines—the eyes, mouth, curled edges, or bright accessory—crisp enough to hold the visual focus. A three-quarter turn and backward glance create subtle movement in an otherwise formal portrait. The composition can be tight and asymmetrical, leaving only a little dark air around the head. Gloss, smoothness, and deep shadow are balanced with visible midtones, avoiding a flat silhouette. The mood is elegant, self-possessed, and theatrically lit without needing environmental detail.
style_prompt_zh: 经典高反差黑白影棚魅力摄影使用紧密取景与精确的定向光。雕塑般的亮部沿头发、面部形面以及肩膀等平滑部位滑过，背后是近乎纯黑的底色。皮肤般表面保留柔软的灰阶过渡，衣物与背景阴影可彼此融合。眼、嘴、卷曲边缘或明亮饰件等少数界定线保持足够锐利，固定视觉焦点。四分之三转身和回望为正式肖像带来微妙动势。构图可以紧凑且不完全对称，头部周围只留少量深色空气。光泽、平滑与深影由可见中间灰平衡，避免成为扁平剪影。气质优雅、自持、带戏剧化布光，无需环境细节。
theme_en: A dramatic monochrome studio headshot of a woman with sculpted short curls turning toward the camera
theme_zh: 一位短卷发女子转头看向相机的戏剧性黑白影棚肖像
name: George Hurrell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
